scene.title: Insert at Head of Linked List
scene.summary: Demonstrates inserting a new node at the beginning of a singly linked list.

beats.title: Start list
beats.narration: The linked list currently holds the nodes 2 → 4 → 6.

beats.title: Node to insert
beats.narration: We create a new node with value 1 ready to be added.

beats.title: Insert at head
beats.narration: Insert the new node at the head, linking it before the former first node.
